desc:
you just moved into a new house. it came with a cat. her name is mei mei.

nobody knows how, but when mei mei is happy money just kind of appears. so feed her, pet her (as much as you want, she pretends to hate it), clean up after her, and spend the cash on MeowNet, the dial-up cat store on your old computer. get her a cardboard box, a roomba she rides around on, a hamster wheel, a disco ball, her own livestream...

she also makes demands. a lot of them. do them and she might actually start to trust you. sometimes she poops gold. don't ask.

the last owner left letters around the house and there are men in sunglasses parked outside. mei mei might not be from around here. there are 2 endings.

play solo or pick up the red phone and bring up to 3 friends over.

if you find a bug join group and let me know

like... favorite... for more.....
